KSEI schedule: last trade at old nominal in regular & negotiated market 3 Apr 2023; FIRST trade at new nominal in regular & negotiated market 4 Apr 2023 (= regular-market ex-date); recording date 5 Apr 2023; distribution of new shares / cash market at new nominal 6 Apr 2023. Bank Mandiri's own AR2023 (PDF p.40, p.201, p.558) says the split 'became effective'/shares listed 'as of 6 April 2023' - that is the distribution/cash-market date, NOT the regular-market ex-date.

actions.note: Penawaran Umum Terbatas (Rights Issue) IX with HMETD: every 400,000 shares on the 12 Jul 2021 register received 116,089 rights; 1 right = 1 new class B share (nominal Rp125) at Rp1,347. Recording 12 Jul; rights trading/exercise 14-21 Jul; allotment 26 Jul 2021. Effective statement 30 Jun 2021; 8,138,620,315 new class B shares listed 28 Jul 2021 (AR2024 PDF p. 791 share-listing chronology), issued shares 28,042,739,205 -> 36,181,359,520. About Rp10.96 tn; Bangkok Bank paid with its Rp10,821,490 juta advance capital payment placed on the Dec-2020 branch integration (AR2024 PDF p. 793, FS Note 1d). EGMS approval 27 Apr 2021. All 455,494,000 shares were issued at Rp2,200 (FS Jun-2026 Note 1b xii, PDF p. 14), taking the total to 6,832,410,700 shares (FS2019 PDF p. 112). PT Mayapada Karunia (26.42%) committed to take up to 120,320,977 shares; Cathay Life (40.00%) did not exercise.

Every 5,000 shares on the 10 Mar 2021 register received 3,659 rights; 1 right = 1 new Series B share (nominal Rp100) at an exercise price of Rp400. 4,999,958,150 new shares offered (max proceeds Rp1,999.98bn); EGMS 4 Jan 2021; OJK effective 26 Feb 2021; HMETD trading and exercise 15-19 Mar 2021; listing 15 Mar 2021. actions.loc: Prospektus PMHMETD XIV (issued 12 Jan 2024), PDF p. 1: 'JADWAL' (cum regular & negotiated market 9 Jan 2024; 'Tanggal Mulai Perdagangan Saham Tanpa HMETD (Ex-Right) di: Pasar Reguler dan Pasar Negosiasi: 10 Januari 2024'; cash market ex 12 Jan 2024; recording date 11 Jan 2024) and offer paragraph (100 old shares -> 226 HMETD at Rp150)
actions.note: PMHMETD XIV (deep-discount rights issue, 2.26 rights per share). Every 100 shares on the 11 Jan 2024 register received 226 rights; 1 right = 1 new Series B share (nominal Rp100) at an exercise price of Rp150. Up to 26,741,153,601 new shares offered (max Rp4,011.2bn); EGMS 2 Oct 2023; OJK effective 29 Dec 2023; HMETD trading and exercise 15-19 Jan 2024; standby-buyer payment 24 Jan 2024. Only 14,335,488,880 shares were taken up (proceeds Rp2,150.3bn, net Rp2,144.5bn), issued on 24 Jan 2024, taking the total to 26,167,857,730 shares (FS2025 Note 29, PDF pp. 93-94). The proceeds stayed in 'Uang muka setoran modal' pending OJK administrative approval through FY2025 and appear as paid-in capital (Rp2,772,088 juta) by 30 Jun 2026.

actions.note: Penawaran Umum Terbatas V (PUT V / PMHMETD V) of PT Bank China Construction Bank Indonesia Tbk: every 100 shares on the 26 Jun 2020 register (16:00 WIB) received 128 rights; 1 right = 1 new share (nominal Rp100) at an exercise price of Rp150. Approved by the EGMS of 11 Oct 2019 (max 32bn shares); OJK effective 16 Jun 2020; cum regular/negotiated market 24 Jun, ex 25 Jun 2020 (cash market cum 26 Jun / ex 29 Jun); rights traded and exercised 30 Jun-13 Jul 2020; standby buyer PT Sinar Mas Multiartha Tbk. 21,288,269,763 new shares issued (16,631,460,751 -> 37,919,730,514; Rp3,193.2bn raised; AR2020 PDF p. 24 'Kronologis Pencatatan Saham', LKT 2020 PDF p. 8; post-PUT shareholder list in the bank's disclosure of 22 Jul 2020, https://www.bankccbi.co.id/news/8). Source is the 'Tambahan informasi dan/atau perbaikan atas Prospektus Ringkas' published 17 Jun 2020 (one body paragraph on PDF p. 3 says 'DPS ... 22 Juni 2020', a typo: the cover, schedule and procedures all say 26 Jun 2020). The exercise price was ABOVE the market (June 2020 closes 113-142, AR2020 PDF p. 23), so the theoretical ex-rights price exceeded the cum price and the rights had no intrinsic value. Not a split: no per-share adjustment factor.
